name: classes-os
description: CLASSES.OS — class management platform (NestJS API, React web, Flutter mobile, Firebase)

scripts.build: npm run build -w apps/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.lint: npm run lint -w apps/api && npm run lint -w apps/web
scripts.emulators: cd firebase && firebase emulators:start --project demo-classes-os --only auth,firestore
